user.title: Connect your amplifier
user.description: Enter its serial device or serial-over-IP address. An existing Monoprice amplifier entry is reused automatically; do not add a second one for the same amplifier.

error.unknown: Connection failed. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.matrix_options: This HDMI matrix entry belongs to the No Hassle AV integration now. Update No Hassle AV to import it.

snapshot.description: Save the selected amplifier zone state for later restoration.

restore.description: Restore the selected amplifier zone snapshot.
